tickets.title: Prepare month-by-month tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule showing how Marzipan Meadow tuition charges can be covered by Elin’s 529 balance, the $21,000 Teacup Comet tuition set-aside, and the Paper Otter Treasury reserve without altering retirement contributions for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain itemized billing packet from college

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve Velvet Acorn 529 balance mismatch

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection

tickets.title: Prepare cost-gap estimate for Rowan scholarships

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing cost projection

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-sequencing plan and tax estimate for using the Paper Otter taxable account’s education reserve, considering unrealized gains in the equity index fund for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
